## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//dotnet:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//dotnet:defs.bzl", "nuget_repo")
```
